posts.title: Amazon Prime Members Can Get 2 Free Years of GrubHub+ PLUS 25% Off!
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here
If you have Amazon Prime and like to have your food delivered, this is a deal you'll LOVE! Head over here to get TWO free years of GrubHub+. You'll avoid pesky delivery fees with the service. You can also use code 25FORDAD to get 25% off your purchase of $20 or more.
After the two-year promo period is over, your GrubHub+ account will renew for $9.99/month...I am making a note to cancel it.
Check out all of the facts:
"What is the Grubhub+ offer for Amazon Prime members?
Amazon Prime members can enjoy a one year trial of Grubhub+ (normally $9.99/month) with their Prime membership. Members that have received a one-year Grubhub+ Amazon Prime trial extension by email from Grubhub will have an additional 365 days from their previous trial expiration date to enjoy their free trial of Grubhub+ benefits through Amazon. As a special limited-time offer, Prime members who redeem June 5, 2023 through July 5, 2023, can also enjoy a total of 24 months of Grubhub+ for free. Prime members who redeem the offer July 6, 2023, or later will still receive 12 months of Grubhub+ for free.
What is included in the free trial of Grubhub+?
Grubhub+ is a monthly membership offering unlimited $0 delivery fees on orders of $12+ (before tax, tip, and fees) at eligible restaurants, access to exclusive member perks—like free food and order discounts—and donation matching. Only a paid subscription of Grubhub+ includes a monthly meal credit (value $10) for pickup orders. See the full Grubhub+ terms and conditions for more information.
How can I redeem my free trial of Grubhub+ membership?
Go to https://www.amazon.com/prime/offer/grubhub/prime-deal/ and click "Activate your Grubhub+ offer"
Sign in to Grubhub or create an account
Agree to the terms and conditions to connect your Prime and Grubhub accounts
Agree to share your Prime membership status with Grubhub
Start enjoying all the benefits of your Grubhub+ trial
What if I’m not a Prime member?
This offer is only available to current Prime members. To join Prime and redeem your Grubhub+ offer, you can sign up using the steps above, then experience all that Prime has to offer, including exclusive shopping, savings, and entertainment benefits.
What if I already have a Grubhub+ membership?
Existing Grubhub+ members are eligible for this offer. However, please note that the monthly meal credit of $10 for pick up orders for paid subscription members is not included in the trial offer. Follow the above steps to sign in or sign up for Prime, then connect to your Grubhub account to activate this offer. If you are participating in a paid Grubhub+ membership at the time of signup, your paid membership will be canceled and your free Grubhub+ trial will begin on the next calendar day immediately following the end of your then-current billing cycle.
Can I link my Prime account to a different Grubhub account?
You are only able to claim one Grubhub+ trial per email associated with an Amazon Prime account (including Amazon Prime Student accounts). If you already claimed a Grubhub+ trial by linking your Amazon Prime account with a Grubhub account that is associated with the same email address, then your Grubhub+ trial will apply to that Grubhub account only and cannot be transferred to other Grubhub accounts.
What if I cancel my Prime membership?
If you end your Prime membership you will lose your free access to Grubhub+. You can sign up for a standard Grubhub+ membership to continue receiving Grubhub+ benefits. If you choose to restart your Prime membership, you will need to redeem this offer again.
Who do I contact if I have an issue connecting my account?
First, verify that you are logged in to Amazon and that your Prime membership is active, then attempt to redeem the offer by visiting amazon.com/grubhub
For questions about your Prime membership, contact Amazon customer service.
For questions about your Grubhub account or Grubhub+ membership, contact Grubhub customer support.
What if I previously redeemed the Prime Student offer for a free Grubhub+ membership?
Prime Student members who have already redeemed the Grubhub+ Student offer will continue to receive free Grubhub+ until December 31, 2022. After that, you will be eligible to redeem this offer for an additional one year of Grubhub+ for free as long as this offer is available.
Will my Grubhub+ Amazon Prime Trial auto-renew with Grubhub after one year?
After your free trial of Grubhub+ ends, Grubhub will charge the payment method associated with your Grubhub account on a monthly basis at the then-current rate (currently $9.99/month). You can cancel any time by contacting Grubhub customer support or visiting the “Grubhub+ membership” section in your Grubhub account settings.
If you have received a 1-year extension on your Grubhub+ Amazon Prime Trial, you will have an additional 365 days from your previous expiration date before your preferred payment method is charged.
How do I cancel my Grubhub+ trial membership?
You will have free access to Grubhub+ with your Prime membership for one year (or two years if you received a one year extension or signed up between June 5, 2023 and July 5, 2023), but you can cancel at any time by visiting the “Grubhub+ membership” section in your Grubhub account settings. If you cancel your trial, your benefits will end immediately.
How do I unlink my Amazon and Grubhub accounts?
Note: Linked Amazon and Grubhub accounts are required to access your Prime Grubhub+ benefits. If you choose to restart your Grubhub+ membership through Prime, you will need to redeem this offer again.
To disconnect your Amazon account:
Visit Your Account on Amazon
Under Other programs, go to Login with Amazon
Select “Remove” next to Grubhub to disconnect your accounts
Will my personal data be shared between Amazon Prime and Grubhub?
By linking your Amazon and Grubhub accounts, you agree that Amazon will share your Prime membership status information with Grubhub for the purposes of enabling your Grubhub offer and that Grubhub may share offer redemption and/or cancellation information with Amazon.
What if my Amazon or Grubhub account is deleted?
Deletion of your Grubhub or Amazon account will result in the termination of your Grubhub+ trial. Currently, there isn’t a way to restore your Grubhub+ trial once your Grubhub or Amazon account is deleted. If you would like to rejoin Grubhub+, you can create a new Grubhub or Amazon account then redeem this offer again. Subject to Grubhub and Amazon terms of use."
Enjoy!

Buck and Rider- I saved my favorite Happy Hour spot for last. Every day from 3-7 in the patio bar, Abby's Oyster bar, and alcove you can enjoy delicious food and drink specials. posts.title: Check Out the AMAZING Freebies from Salad and Go for Truck Drivers, Delivery Drivers, Farmers, Teachers, Healthcare Workers, First Responders, and More Amazing People Who Are Keeping Life Going!
posts.excerpt: I am a HUGE fan of Salad and Go...their $1 green teas and cold brews are some of my go-to's! Their response to Covid-19 has made me an even BIGGER fan! Check…
posts.text:
I am a HUGE fan of Salad and Go...their $1 green teas and cold brews are some of my go-to's! Their response to Covid-19 has made me an even BIGGER fan! Check out what they're doing:
"we are in our 3rd week of FREE Salads and Breakfast Burritos!  We are continuing to honor those that are working on the frontlines as well as those that may have lost their jobs during this crisis. We are in this together!
Thursday, 4/2: Truck drivers, Delivery drivers, Postal service, Manufacturing and Warehouse workers, and Farmers
Friday, 4/3: Child Care and Teachers
Saturday, 4/4 and Sunday, 4/5: Healthcare Workers and First Responders
Just show our drive-thru cashier a form of identification to your place of work, whether it is a badge, paystub, or uniform. One salad or breakfast burrito for each person present with one of these forms of ID only through the drive-thru, not available through online ordering. Because our walk-up window is closed for the safety of our team and guests, we ask that those in trucks that cannot fit in the drive-thru please come before or after work. Our salads do hold quite well in the refrigerator for a couple days. Thank you in advance for your honesty and integrity around this, as we help those listed above this week.
Please understand that we, just like all of us, are doing our best to help where needed, but even with this we know we are still not able to help everyone. We will continue to help as long as we are in a position to do so.
DONATE: If you are in a position to help and would like to donate, we are still accepting donations to UMOM New Day Centers and St. Mary's Food Bank, which can now be made through our drive-thru!  You can also donate by simply downloading our app (available on iOS and Android) and proceeding as though you are going to place an order, selecting any location, day and time. Select the icon "Donations" and proceed to checkout. Donations can be made without purchasing any food. You can even donation online at saladandgo.com, through the online ordering tab. Let's help these two great, local non-profits fight to support those in need."
Head over here to follow them on Facebook and check out their deals next week (and beyond).
Thank you so much Asther and Carole!

Use your library card to get free admissions to museums all over the valley with the Act 1 Culture Pass. You can actually "check out" two free admissions to fun places like Arcosanti, the Heard Museum, the Phoenix Art Museum, the Irish Cultural Center, and many other museums you may have never been to. I know we all love tacos and lucky for us the Arizona Taco Festival happens during Fall Break this year! Head over here to find discounted Sunday tickets to the event happening at West World in Scottsdale. You'll pay $9 instead of $18.33 and keep in mind that tickets can sell out at anytime. You must buy the deal 24 hours before you plan to use it. This could be a great place to meet up with friends or enjoy a family date night!
Enjoy your fall break!

posts.title: Sign Up Your 8-12 Year Old for FREE Apple Camp! Spots Go Quickly!
posts.excerpt: It's time once again for FREE Apple Summer Camp. If you have an 8-12 year old, rush over here to reserve your spot. There are three options this year:
posts.text:
It's time once again for FREE Apple Summer Camp. If you have an 8-12 year old, rush over here to reserve your spot. There are three options this year:
"Telling Stories with Clips
Future filmmakers ages 8-12 will explore the creative process of telling stories using video, photos, and music. Campers will brainstorm and storyboard their ideas. They’ll get hands-on in groups to capture short videos, edit and enhance their shots with fun graphics and filters, and add opening and closing titles in the Clips app on iPad. On the final day, they’ll present their video stories.
Beat Making and Songwriting with GarageBand
In this three-day session, kids ages 8-12 will discover the magic of beat making and songwriting. They’ll start by exploring basic elements of song structure and how beats create the foundation of a song. Campers will get hands-on as they create music using Touch Instruments, add vocals, and fine-tune their creations with GarageBand on iPad. On day 3, they’ll share their songs with the group.
Coding with Sphero Robots
In this three-day session for kids ages 8-12, we’ll introduce the fundamentals of coding using Sphero robots. Each day Campers will learn a new coding concept and practice problem-solving skills. They’ll partner up for fun activities to program their Sphero to change colors, create sounds, complete challenges, and more. Then they’ll apply their coding skills to design their own games."
Enjoy!

"Bush: This alternative-rock outfit fronted by Gavin Rossdale went on a hot streak of 18 consecutive Top 40 singles on the Modern Rock and Mainstream Rock charts; 6 of those singles reached the No. 1, including “Comedown” and “Glycerine.” They’ve sold more than 20 million albums in the United States and Canada alone, and aim to continue momentum with their latest album, Black and White Rainbow, which People magazine described as a “triumphant return.”
Stone Temple Pilots: Since taking rock-radio by storm with their chart-topping 1992 debut, Core, Stone Temple Pilots have sold more than 70 million albums worldwide behind hits such as “Sex Type Thing,” “Wicked Garden,” and the Grammy Award-winning “Plush.” They continue to add to their legacy with their self-titled seventh album, which is the first to include new singer Jeff Gutt and features the lead single “Meadow.”
The Cult: Critics have hailed the band as “incendiary,” “ground-breaking,” and “transcendent,” but the band members themselves choose to look forward rather than rest on their laurels. They consider themselves survivors, marginalized and vulgarized, much in the same way their many of their song subjects have been."

posts.title: As Seen on Your Life A to Z...Money Saving MYTHS!
posts.excerpt: Thanks so much for tuning into my 3TV segment about money saving myths. If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll join the totally FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list…
posts.text:
Thanks so much for tuning into my 3TV segment about money saving myths. If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll join the totally FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list (unsubscribe at anytime). Please tell a friend about my site too so we can all “live life better for less” together. You can also find out first about the latest and greatest bargains when you “like” Alicia’s Deals on Facebook and follow me on Twitter.
MYTH: It's always cheaper to pay with cash.
Most people say that you'll always spend less with cash and I say that's just not true for everyone. If you do pay with cash, always ask if there's a cash discount. My nail salon gives 10% off for paying with cash.
If there's no discount, it's always better to use a high rewards credit card. There are so many out there, check out the benefits and figure out what's best for you. My card gives me 2.05% back to go toward travel, I like to say I pay 97.95% for everything. So if I put $25,000 a year on a credit card, that's over $500 back that I wouldn't have if I used cash. $25000 a year seems like a lot to put on a credit card, but if you use it at the grocery store, use it to pay your internet bill, use it on any bills that don't charge fees, you'll really see the bonuses add up. Just make sure you pay the bill in full each and every month. We should NEVER pay even one cent in credit card interest.
I like paying with credit cards better than debit cards because you get the added benefits and you get better protection in most cases than you do with a debit card. If someone steals your information with a credit card they won't have the ability to empty your bank account like they do with a debit card. Just make sure you're not spending money you wouldn't have spent with cash. Fiscal responsibility is key.
MYTH: It's usually more expensive to buy online than to shop in store.
Get in the habit of using FREE money saving programs. If you shop online a lot, make sure you're signed up for programs like Ebates and Top Cash Back. They give you a percentage back of whatever you buy. Search for promo codes wherever you're shopping, online it's really easy to combine promo codes to save the most money possible. At Kohl's you can combine up to four codes on the same item! If you use Ebates, you'll save even more on top of that.
MYTH: Costco is always a good deal
Costco does have some great prices, but they have some really high prices on items too. You can often find the same items for a lot less when they're on sale at the grocery stores, do your research. If you won't go through the items before they expire, it's definitely not a good deal to shop there. The one item I love at Costco is the $4.99 rotisserie chicken. It's consistently good and huge.
MYTH: If an Item You Already Bought Goes on Sale, Too Bad
Most stores will credit you the difference within a certain period of time, it's always worth a phone call or e-mail. You'll be amazed what stores will do to keep you from taking something back.

It's not hard to see why Sanctuary Spa at Sanctuary Camelback Mountain Resort & Spa was named one of the world's top spas by Travel + Leisure magazine and featured in Groupon's . For starters, there's the backdrop. Located not 5 miles from downtown Scottsdale, Sanctuary Spa is spread across 53 acres of pristine desert landscape. The therapist will then apply organic herbs along the body's meridians, concluding the service with a Thai massage that's augmented by a heated herbal compress.
Watsu: During this deeply relaxing 60-minute aquatic-therapy session, the client floats in warm water as a massage therapist gently cradles, rocks, and stretches the body. Because it takes place in the water, clients are able to increase their range of motion with less pain.
Sweet Dreams: Before guests head to bed, one of Sanctuary Spa's staff members arrives in their room to perform this luxurious treatment. Clients breathe in citrus and lavender scents during a full-body scrub followed by a scalp massage, hot bath, and tea service.

"Spread across 20 acres, dozens of rides, slides, and water attractions send visitors splashing through scorching summer days. At the Waikiki Beach wave pool, 2.5 million gallons of water swell and swirl to create refreshing waves every three minutes. Captain Cook’s Landing cools down toddlers, and winding slides tout the names of natural phenomena such as Cyclone, Tsunami, and Tom Hanks. The water park is accompanied by free parking. Rafts, boogie boards, and surfboards are available to rent.
Big Surf Waterpark
In 1966, Big Surf Waterpark founder Phil Dexter built his first model of a wave machine in his backyard, a place he affectionally named Tahiti Phil's. With some help, and several models later—including one assembled inside an abandoned billiards hall—he perfected the contraption, making it the centerpiece of his newly opened waterpark in 1969. Dexter's invention instantly snagged press from Time, Sports Illustrated, and Life, and today, it remains Big Surf Waterpark's 2.5-million-gallon keynote attraction. One of Big Surf Waterpark's newest attractions is the Mauna Kea Zip Line, which starts high in the air before zipping over the wave pool. Over the years, despite Arizona's lack of rain or gigantic sprinkler, the park has managed to grow around the wave pool, and its current 20-acre campus features dozens of slides, rides, and areas for all ages. Big Surf's real estate has also played host to entertainment events, including concerts from Pink Floyd, Elton John, and the Beach Boys."

"In 1984, Space Biospheres Ventures purchased a few unassuming acres north of Tucson in the shadow the Santa Catalina Mountains. There, the company expanded its sci-fi-sounding activities—the development of space-colonization technology—and built what would evolve into Biosphere 2, recently seen on The Today Show.
Designed to re-create Earth's ecosystems, the gigantic glass enclosure (some 7.2 million cubic feet and 91 feet tall in some parts) is famous for housing biospherians in the 1990s. The researchers lived completely sealed inside for extended periods, giving scientists groundbreaking data on human survivability and interaction with particular bionetworks.
The University of Arizona had the 40-acre Biosphere 2 campus donated in 2011, maintaining it as a hub of serious research while expanding its mission to encompass interactive educational outreach. Each year, thousands pass through the on-site labs and classrooms as well as stroll the Biosphere 2 interior to view films, experience multimedia exhibits, or embark on guided tours. Tours venture into the actual ecosystems, allowing earthlings to note biodiversity, smell fresh precipitation in the rain forest, and savor the softness of savannah grassland underfoot until the resident grumpy old man yells at you to get the heck off his lawn. Before their dramatic conclusion at a million-gallon ocean tank, tours delve into the basement to explore the technosphere, where visitors can witness the deep inhales and exhales of the sphere’s respiratory system."

posts.text:
Head over here to save up to 5% off Octane Raceway races in Scottsdale! This is supposed to be so much fun! Keep in mind that junior drivers must be at least 54 inches tall.
Check out the details:
"Choose from Four Options
$20 for two races and helmet rental for one person, valid Monday–Thursday only ($42.85 value)
$39 for four races and helmet rental for up to two, valid Monday–Thursday only (up to $85.70 value)
$25 for two races and helmet rental for one person, valid any time ($42.85 value)
$49 for four races and helmet rental for up to two, valid any time (up to $85.70 value)
Octane Raceway
It's hard to say which is more distinctive: the karts zipping around Octane Raceway or the track itself. During each lap on the 1/3-mile course, drivers zoom through an indoor area, then weave around an outdoor section that's covered by a permanent steel canopy, making for a hybrid experience rarely found in American go-kart tracks not owned by bored supervillains.
An equally rare find in the U.S. is the raceway's fleet of 32 Sodi RTX karts, all imported from France, whose electric motors give off zero emissions while reaching speeds of up to 45 miles per hour. Drivers who can stay in control at these top speeds are in for success: the winner of each race is determined not by who finishes a given number of laps first, but by who puts up the fastest single lap time, a result that's posted both at the track and online for posterity.
Races take place in a 65,000-square-foot space that doubles as a gathering place for parties and corporate events for up to 500 attendees. In addition to racing, the raceway is also home to off-track activities that include shooting pool in the billiards room, arcade games, and melting burgers and pizza into rocket fuel at the Trackside Bar and Grill."

posts.text:
Thanks so much for tuning into my Your Life A to Z segment today! If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll “like” Alicia’s Deals on Facebook, follow me on Twitter and join the FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list (unsubscribe at anytime). So funny, we just went to San Francisco. The example above is inspiring me to make a book (especially because it’s free)!
Heading on a weekend vacation (yay!) and wanted to put my favorite deal for family fun up top before I go! Have a great weekend and looking forward to checking back in early next week!
You can head over here to get Pogo Passes for just $39.98 each with code ALICIA (usually $99.95). They are the best value around and are good for a FULL YEAR! You get free admissions into places all over town (so you get to see a lot of what the valley has to offer including Sunsplash, Castles and Coasters, the Phoenix Zoo, Dbacks Games, and LOTS More)! Since I’ve written about them last, they’re now good at select Phoenix Mercury Games and at Pump it Up in Tempe and Peoria! Each pass is worth $1200 (will be worth $1500 when Fat Cats opens this summer) and is a WONDERFUL value. It pays for itself so fast and you’ll have wonderful memories!
Check out what Alicia’s Deals reader Rachel had to say about the passes on the facebook page:
“This was one of the best purchases we’ve made! So much fun stuff to do with family for a great price!! I even bought 2 for my college aged daughter and her boyfriend to have dates–They are struggling students. thank you SO much Alicia for this deal. We have great family memories. We will be re-newing ours for sure!” Thank you Rachel!
Check out the new place the Pogo Pass is good! Pogo Pass is excited to announce that Fat Cats in Gilbert will be accepting Pogo Passes starting July 5th! Each Pogo Pass member will have access to 1 bowling visit per month (2 games), and 1 Glow Golf visit per month. Must be used in separate visits. Check out their website at http://www.fatcatsfun.com/.
Here’s what’s included:
Each pass holder will enjoy one general admission ticket to Sunsplash during the year. Opening Day is May 16th! General admission tickets are usually $29.99. Head over here for hours and days they’ll be open and for more information about the park!
Castles and Coasters: Each Pogo Pass holder recieves one (1) visit to Castles~n~Coasters for a *Silver Pass (worth $29.99). This includes unlimited rides and mini golf.We went and had SUCH a wonderful day! We even got to enjoy the ropes course! The kids have been talking about the place non stop.
Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Some experiences require an additional fee. Admission to ZooLights and select special events is not included. An adult general admission is usually $20, so this is a $40 value for adults. There are water areas and playgrounds so you can cool off in the hot summer months!
Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season.
Available Hours
Pass holders can choose two (2) of the available Games for the 2015 MLB Regular Season.
Wed, 6/17 vs. LAA 6:40 PM
Fri, 7/24 vs. MIL 6:40 PM
Tue, 8/11 vs. PHI 6:40 PM
Fri, 10/2 vs. HOU 6:40 PM
Registration button appears on this page (2) weeks prior to game day. Must register your Pogo Pass to reserve tickets at will call. Login to your account for a list of your available passes. June 17th is my son’s birthday and he’s definitely excited to go to the game!
Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to Pump It Up in Tempe or Peoria two (2) times. To gain admission, simply present your Pogo Pass at the front desk.
Available during regular business hours for open jump Monday-Friday. Mon-Fri: 10am-12pm, 12pm-2pm, 2pm-4pm Mon-Thurs: 4pm-7pm Fri: 4pm-6pm
Tempe: Ages 2yrs (34″) and up.
Peoria: Ages 2yrs (34″) to 10yrs old.
Pass holders can attend three (3) Games for the WNBA Regular Season. Available games are as follows.
Fri, June 19 vs. Connecticut Sun 7:00 PM
Sat, July 18 vs. New York Liberty 7:00 PM
Fri, August 21 vs. Los Angeles Sparks 7:00 PM
Registration opens two (2) weeks prior to game date. Must register your Pogo Pass by clicking the link that will appear on this page to reserve your tickets at will call. Tickets are emailed to all reserved pass holders the day before the game. Registration closes 24 hrs prior to game time.
Your pass will get you into Makutu’s Island in Chandler twice with your year-long pass (Monday-Friday). Tickets are usually $10 each.
IDEA museum (used to be Arizona Museum for Youth): Each pass holder can attend i.d.e.a Museum Two (2) times during normal business hours (closed on Monday). Children 1 yrs of age and up are $8 admission if they do not have a valid Pogo Pass. Children are required to wear socks in play area. ** Excludes opening weekend (Fri, Sat, Sun) of opening exhibitions, 3 weekends a year. Simply present your Pogo Pass at admissions desk for entrance. Since admission is usually $8, this adds $16 of value to your POGO pass.
Enchanted Island: Your Pogo Pass is good for a Day Pass four (4) times at Enchanted Island Park Friday and Sundays during regular business hours. Not valid during Enchanted Island special events (I would call ahead before you go). Limited capacity, first come first serve. Some rides may require additional charge. A day pass is usually $17 for anyone under 54 inches, $10 for anyone over.
Sun Devil Athletics: Pogo Pass is a accepted for general admission tickets to ALL of the following ASU athletic home games: Women’s Basketball, Soccer, Wrestling, Volleyball, Gymnastics, Track and Field. **No need to pre-register for tickets to attend. Simply present your Pogo pass at will call or the front gate to gain admissions.
National Comedy Theater: Each pass holder can attend 2 shows. MUST call for a reservation. Seating is limited. First come first serve. Note: Please honor your reservations. Reservations will be cancelled for those who are not in their seats 5 minutes prior to show. Tickets are usually $14 each.
Skateland: Each pass holder can attend Skateland two (2) times per month. Skateland has three (3) different locations available to pass holders. Simply present your Pogo Pass card at the front counter to gain admission to Skateland. Skate Rental not included. There are 3 locations (one in Mesa, one in Glendale, and one in Chandler).
Phoenix Rock Gym: Pogo Pass holders can attend Phoenix Rock Gym two (2) times. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front counter to gain admission to Phoenix Rock Gym. Waiver required for 18 and younger. Limited capacity, first come first serve. *Climbing gear available upon request for $5.
Stratum Laser Tag: Pass holders can attend stratum two (2) times. Each pass holder receives one (1) complimentary game of laser tag each time they attend. Pass is valid for 12 months. NOTE: Pogo Passes may be used on Mondays and Wednesdays 4:30-close. Pogo Passes may not be used during school holiday breaks or Stratum’s designated holiday hours. No exceptions.
Tempe Paintball: Pogo Pass holders can attend Tempe Paintball one (1) time per month for 12 months that include gun rental, air, and 100 paintballs. Check for seasonal hours and scheduled groups or events before scheduling your visit. Keep in mind that all participants must be 10 years or older, and must sign a waiver before prior to entering the arena. Note: This is not good on Saturdays.
Arizona Rattlers: (1) One ticket per game per pass holder for three (3) Arizona Rattlers home games at the US Airways Center for the AFL regular season.
Available Games for the 2015 season:
Sat, July 11 vs. Las Vegas Outlaws 6:00 PM
Sat, August 8 vs. Portland Thunder 6:00 PM
You must register yor pass for tickets, registration opens up two weeks before the event.

"Varekai—the Romany word for “wherever”—embodies and celebrates the nomadic spirit of the circus itself. A winged hero, wounded from a rub-up against the sun, plummets from the sky into a magical forest populated by surreal creatures. They dazzle the eye with incredible feats of strength and agility, as well as more than 130 vibrant costumes by Academy Award-winning designer Eiko Eshioka, who drew inspiration from the textures and shapes of the natural world."

posts.title: Happy First Friday! FREE Admission to The Children's Museum of Phoenix, The Heard Museum, and the Phoenix Art Museum!
posts.excerpt: Hooray! Today (12/5) is First Friday! If you don’t have plans, you may want to head to Downtown Phoenix to enjoy the gorgeous weather, some beautiful art, an…
posts.text:
Hooray! Today (12/5) is First Friday! If you don’t have plans, you may want to head to Downtown Phoenix to enjoy the gorgeous weather, some beautiful art, an Ollie the Trolley ride, and some FREE museums! Anyone that says Phoenix has no culture has obviously never been to First Friday!
Head to the Children’s Museum of Phoenix where everyone will get in free from 5-9 PM. Tickets are usually $11 each, so this is quite an opportunity to play for less!
Visit the Heard Museum for their First Friday Native + You program. Everyone will get into the museum FOR FREE from 6-10 (tickets are usually $18 for adults, $7.50 for kids). This month the theme is "literary treasures".
Still have energy? Go to the Phoenix Art Museum for their First Friday event. Everyone will get in for free from 6-10 PM (tickets are usually $15 for adults, $6 for kids).
Enjoy a cool Phoenix night at the museum with drinks from ArTenders and live music by Elvis Before Noon! Music starts at 7:00 p.m.
Exhibitions on view:
The West Select: A Western Art Invitational Sale and Exhibition - $5 for adults, $3 for youth after 6 p.m.
Vanitas: Contemporary Reflections on Love and Death from the Collection of Stéphane Janssen - Free after 6 p.m.
All That Glitters is Not Gold: Platinum Photography from the Center for Creative Photography - Free after 6 p.m.
Don Coen: The Migrant Series - Free after 6 p.m.
Fashioned In America - Free after 6 p.m.
Sacred Stories and Images of the Buddha: The Vessantara Jataka Scroll - Free after 6 p.m.
Paulo Bruscky: Art is Our Last Hope - Free after 6 p.m.
Phoenix Art Museum is one of four Artlink Phoenix First Friday Trolley hubs! Park and enjoy the museum then take the trolley tour and explore all the downtown Phoenix arts and culture destinations. The museum is conveniently located by the Central and McDowell Valley Metro Lightrail station.
First Friday is closed this week but will be back in January!
Just to recap, if you take your family of four (two adults, two kids) to the Children’s Museum of Phoenix, the Heard Museum, and the Phoenix Art Museum, you’ll save a whopping $137 on admission (more if you have more kids).
Enjoy!

“Ahoy There Mateys! Friday, September 19, any buccaneer to enter a participating Krispy Kreme and talk like a pirate gets one FREE Original Glazed® doughnut. To the landlubber who dares to wear full pirate attire goes a bounty of one FREE dozen Original Glazed doughnuts. Offer good on International Talk Like a Pirate Day, September 19th, only.
To claim yer bounty on September 19, ye must:
• Come in to a participating Krispy Kreme shop and Talk like a pirate for one FREE Original Glazed doughnut.
• Come in to a participating Krispy Kreme location in full pirate costume for one FREE dozen Original Glazed doughnuts. Qualifying pirate costumes must include three or more of the following items:
• Eye Patch
• Pirate Hat
• Bandana
• Peg Leg
• Parrot on Shoulder
• Pirate Shirt / Loose white shirt
• Knickers
• Leather Belt
• Silver and gold necklaces and earrings
• Pirate Hook
• Pointy black boots or ragged brown sandals
Offer good for one free doughnut per customer who talks like a pirate to a Krispy Kreme team member at a participating shop. One free dozen Original Glazed doughnuts per customer who wears a full pirate costume into a participating Krispy Kreme location. Redeemable on September 19, 2014 only at participating Krispy Kreme US locations. Non-participating locations include: All CT shops, Anderson, SC and Spartanburg, SC.”

posts.text:
If you haven't yet, you can still head over here to get POGO Passes for just $39.98 each (usually $99.95) with promo code ALICIA. We got three and the kids and I are having "Camp Markham" for at least a week this summer! We can't wait to visit all of the places! Remember that the passes are good for a FULL YEAR (and have a full value of $1500 each if you go everywhere)!
Here's a sampling of where you'll get to visit:
Sunsplash: Each pass holder can attend Golfland Sunsplash one (1) time. Your pass is good for one (1) SunSplash General admission ticket. Simply present your Pogo pass at Sunsplash Guest Service window to be scanned to obtain waterpark wristband. Regular price to get into Sunsplash is $29.99 so this almost pays for your pass! The park is open to passholders now!
Sea Life Aquarium: Each Pass holder can attend Arizona Sea life Aquarium two (2) times. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front desk to gain admission to the Aquarium.
Phoenix Zoo: Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Some experiences require an additional fee. Admission to ZooLights and select special events is not included.
Stratum Laser Tag: Pass holders can attend stratum two (2) times. Each pass holder receives one (1) complimentary game of laser tag each time they attend. Pass is valid for 12 months.
Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season. Check out theselect dates here.
Phoenix Jump Street: Each Pass holder can attend Phoenix Jump Street two (2) times. Pass is good for a one (1) hour jump session each attendance. Pass is valid for twelve (12) months. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front counter to gain admission to Phoenix Jump Street. Limited capacity, first come first serve.
And LOTS LOTS more! Rattlers games, Brunswick bowling, Phoenix Rock Gym, Enchanted Island, Comedy Theater, Skateland, and Tempe Paintball are all included! Head over here to see everywhere the pass is taken. Don’t forget to use promo code ALICIA to get your passes for $39.98 each (everyone over two will need their own pass).
Enjoy!
